sections.description: Provides the stable content, data, geography, relationship, and site-context services for the Global 360 platform.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Add trusted clinic and doctor name mail tags to patient review notifications, including Clinic overall and HTML escaping.
  • Keep ID validation/storage unchanged and ignore browser-supplied name values.

1.2.0

  • Add private review Trash, prior-state Restore, and confirmed permanent deletion with capability and nonce protection.
  • Invalidate public review caches on lifecycle changes. Add previous-status schema column automatically.

1.1.1

  • Detect review forms by the complete CF7 field signature across sites; remove form hash configuration.
  • Share detection across dropdowns, assets, validation, and private storage.

1.1.0

  • Add shared patient review submission, private storage, validation, duplicate protection, staff moderation, and approved-only public queries.
  • Support dependent clinic/doctor choices and public profile permalinks; fix optional admin pagination sanitization.

1.0.2

  • Adds a 50-state public directory collection while retaining District of Columbia normalization support.

1.0.1

  • Stage 2 release with request-scoped entity memoization, optimized relationship indexes, and isolated WordPress updater source handling.

1.0.0

  • Initial Platform Core release with shared Clinic, Doctor, geography, relationship, ownership, and site-context contracts.
